title: learning-block-engine-track
intention: The Learning Block gets its inner engine in code — one reusable candidates-loop + evaluation-loop that runs any block from its declared domain knowledge and constraints, state-logged so recorded runs compile into deterministic Python + graph tree, with 'cheaper and still right' measured, never hoped.
why: WHAT AKIEN WAS EXPERIENCING, 2026-08-02: 'as soon as we switch from fable to opus, we start spiralling down. I CANNOT keep track of all those details.' Same day, he ran the design conversation with Haiku — the smallest model — successfully, because he fed it one bounded question per turn and carried the state himself. The engine exists to give every block that property with the ARTIFACT as the carrier instead of Akien or the model's attention. This is the first code step of I-the-system-is-a-learning-block ('we will have to implement that in code once we have sorted out how' — the Haiku transcript, ~/.akien/20260802.AkienOnWhatIWantTheProjectToDoLONGVERSION.txt, is the sorting-out, and its checklist reproduces that intention's corpus almost item for item). Cashes the corpus lines 'Demonstrate Inference Compilation into graph trees and code' and 'Demonstrate stackable learning brick concept — perform at least some of the build outside of the LLM'.
traces_to: Law 1 — the resolver is spent on the novel: one reusable engine, not re-deriving the loop per skill
Law 4 — enforced by physics: the candidates-loop and evaluation-loop are structure, not prose

proves_green.prove_gate: proofs beside the code at cairn/machines/learning_block/proofs/, sealed under the tester (netns). Teeth: the engine runs one block end-to-end with a full state log (child 1 PROVED); recorded runs compile into a deterministic floor (child 2); the compiled floor agrees with the model path on FRESH tasks at measurably lower cost (child 3). A compile that memorizes FAILS validate on fresh tasks (Law 8).
proves_green.entry_gate: BUILDME refuses without a berthed chart chain claiming this ticket plus intent berth on file.
proves_green.parent_crossing: children prove before the parent crosses — child 1 PROVED 2026-08-02; children 2 and 3 cast when their named conditions are met (>=5 training-typed traces for child 2, first compiled floor for child 3).
proves_green.durability: committed and pushed to both repos.

falsifier.proves_red: DONE when one existing block runs through the engine end-to-end with a full state log, its recorded runs compile into a deterministic floor, and proof:validate shows the compiled floor agreeing with the model path on FRESH tasks at measurably lower cost. HOLLOW-PROOF GUARD (Law 8): a compile that memorizes must FAIL validate on fresh tasks. WRONG-INTENT TELL: if a second block requires per-block special cases inside the engine, the 'one engine, different data' hypothesis is falsified — stop and reconcile, do not accrete cases. '5-10 traces suffice to compile' is a HYPOTHESIS (Law 3) and is what child 2's cast tests first.
falsifier.horizon: Child 1 is PROVED. Child 2 casts when child 1's watch reports >=5 training-typed traces. Child 3 casts when child 2 emits its first floor. The parent crosses when all three are proved. The horizon is the trace corpus accumulating — deliberately gated on real data, not forced.

how: Build one reusable candidates-loop + evaluation-loop engine that runs any learning block from its declared domain knowledge and evaluation criteria. The engine is a machine; the block parameterizes it.
